Game Overview

Traffic Race puts players into a racing experience centered on speed through sunlit Californian streets in Traffic Race, a thrilling dash for survival. Master slick maneuvers with intuitive controls as you dodge bustling traffic, experiencing increasing challenges with every passing second. Balance exhilarating high-speed drives with strategic caution to achieve the ultimate score without crashing.
